positions.label: Narshe Mines
tips: Nothing closes yet. Narshe's locked treasure room and a few early chests upgrade their contents if you leave them until the World of Ruin.

positions.label: Figaro Castle
tips: Buy Edgar's tools; the Auto Crossbow carries the first half of the game.

positions.label: South Figaro & Mt. Kolts
tips: Leave the South Figaro basement chests alone — they refill with better gear in the World of Ruin.

positions.label: Returners' Hideout
tips: Refuse Banon three times before accepting: the chest by the bed holds a Genji Glove instead of a Gauntlet.

positions.label: The Three Scenarios
tips: Sabin's scenario is a string of one-time places: the Imperial Camp, the Phantom Train, Baren Falls. Take what you see. Shadow is with you at inns here — his dreams start playing.
Gau joins on the Veldt during Sabin's scenario. Feed him Rages from the fights you have already had.

positions.label: Battle for Narshe
tips: Choose party members for the snowfield defence carefully; nothing is missable, but Kefka's troops are the first real test.

positions.label: Zozo
tips: Set the clock (6:10:50) for Edgar's Chainsaw. From here Lone Wolf sits on Narshe's cliffs: Mog or the Gold Hairpin, decide before the Floating Continent.

positions.label: Jidoor & the Opera House
tips: Jidoor's auction house sells the Golem and ZoneSeek magicite when your gil is high enough. Nothing at the opera is missable.

positions.label: Vector & the Magitek Factory
tips: The Magitek Research Facility is one visit: sweep its chests before the mine-cart escape.

positions.label: The Sealed Gate
tips: The Emperor's banquet is graded: talk to every soldier, answer diplomatically, take the exact pauses. The top score adds the Tintinabar.

positions.label: Thamasa
tips: Last stop before the point of no return. If Mog joined via Lone Wolf, ride the Lethe River with him for the Water Harmony dance — there is no water terrain in the World of Ruin.

positions.label: The Floating Continent
tips: WAIT FOR SHADOW at the airship ledge. Jump early and he is gone from the rest of the game. The World of Balance ends here.

positions.label: Solitary Island
tips: Feed Cid only the lively fish. Whether he lives changes how Celes leaves the island — nothing else.

positions.label: Tzen & Mobliz
tips: Tzen's collapsing house: sweep the chests while Sabin holds the roof. Terra stays in Mobliz for now.

positions.label: Nikeah & Figaro
tips: Follow the Crimson Robbers to Figaro's basement. Edgar is back once the tunnels are cleared.

positions.label: Kohlingen & Darill's Tomb
tips: Setzer's tomb run ends with the Falcon. Everything from here on is optional — and none of it closes.

positions.label: The Falcon — World Reopens
tips: The whole recruitment web is open. Ruined Narshe first: Mog, Tritoch, the hole behind the esper for Umaro, the weapon shop's Ragnarok choice, the Cursed Shield.

positions.label: Mt. Zozo & the Veldt
tips: Cyan on Mt. Zozo, Gau by Leaping with three party members, Shadow (or Relm) in the Veldt cave. Shadow then needs a Colosseum duel for the Striker.

positions.label: Owzer's Mansion & Ebot's Rock
tips: Relm from the gallery, then Strago from the Fanatics' Tower with Relm in the party, then Hidon at Ebot's Rock with Strago along.

positions.label: The Phoenix Cave
tips: Two parties. Locke is at the heart of it; the Phoenix magicite comes out cracked.

positions.label: Ancient Castle & the Dragons
tips: Odin is petrified beneath Figaro's tunnels; the hidden throne-room switch upgrades him to Raiden and that is permanent. Six dragons are reachable before the tower.

positions.label: Kefka's Tower
tips: Three parties, the last two dragons, and Crusader once all eight are down. You can leave the tower — nothing here closes.

items.name: Genji Glove

route.why: Refuse Banon's plea three times, then accept — the reward changes

items.notes: Say no to Banon three times before agreeing and the chest by the bed holds a Genji Glove instead of a Gauntlet.

items.name: Sabin's scenario sweep
items.location: Imperial Camp · Phantom Train · Baren Falls

route.why: The camp packs up and the train never stops again

items.notes: Open what you pass: the Imperial Camp's chests, every car of the Phantom Train (including the monster-in-a-box), the ghost merchants' stock. Verify contents on your version.

items.name: Shadow's dreams
items.location: Any inn, with Shadow in the party
items.notes: Sleep at inns while Shadow travels with you; four dreams tell his story. Each is a small chance per night — and the last two only exist if he survives the Floating Continent.

items.name: Chainsaw (Edgar)

route.why: Set the clock (6:10:50) while you're here for the story

items.notes: Every townsperson lies about the time. Zozo stays reachable in the World of Ruin.

items.name: The delayed-chest trick
items.notes: Several early chests upgrade their contents if left unopened until the World of Ruin (e.g. South Figaro basement, Narshe cliff chests). Patience pays in Elixirs and top-tier gear.

items.name: Lone Wolf: save Mog

route.why: Decide before the Floating Continent — one or the other

items.notes: The thief holds Mog hostage on the cliff. Wait him out and choose Mog — he joins now (and can still be recruited in the World of Ruin either way).

items.name: Lone Wolf: Gold Hairpin
items.notes: Choosing the Gold Hairpin (halves MP costs) over Mog. Mog still joins in the World of Ruin — the hairpin is what's actually at stake.

items.name: Water Harmony (Mog's water dance)
items.location: Lethe River — ride the raft again with Mog

route.why: The only water terrain in the game is in the World of Balance

items.notes: Win one battle on the Lethe River (or the Serpent Trench) with Mog in the party. No water battlefield exists after the world ends — this is the one dance that can be lost forever.

items.name: World of Balance-only Rages (Gau)
items.location: The Veldt — Leap after fighting the formations
items.notes: Several formations never appear after the world ends — Imperial Camp soldiers, Phantom Train ghosts, some Floating Continent beasts. Fight them, then Leap on the Veldt before the continent. Verify the exact list for your version.

items.name: Golem & ZoneSeek (auction house)
items.notes: Both magicite rotate into the auction once you carry enough gil (roughly 20,000 and 10,000). Available in both worlds; buy when they show.

items.name: Magitek Research Facility sweep

route.why: Vector burns; the factory never reopens

items.notes: Open every chest on the way to the mine-cart escape. Verify contents on your version.

items.name: The Emperor's banquet

options.label: Charm Bangle tier
options.note: A solid score adds the Charm Bangle.

options.label: Tintinabar tier
options.note: Talk to every soldier, answer diplomatically, take exactly the right pauses; the top bracket adds the Tintinabar.

route.why: Answer well — rewards scale with your score

items.notes: One conversation, one grade. Save before the palace.

items.name: WAIT FOR SHADOW

route.why: Let the escape timer run to ~5 seconds — jump early and Shadow dies forever

items.notes: At the airship ledge, choose to wait until Shadow arrives. Leaving without him removes him — and everything downstream of him — from the rest of the game.

items.name: Keep Cid alive

route.why: Feed him only the lively fast fish

items.notes: Catch the fast-swimming fish; slow ones make him worse. Whether he lives changes how Celes leaves the island.

items.name: Tzen — the collapsing house
items.location: Tzen — the house Sabin holds up

route.why: Grab the chests inside before the child is out — the house is gone after

items.notes: Sabin rejoins holding the roof. Sweep the rooms on the way to the kid; verify contents on your version.

items.name: Terra rejoins

route.why: Return with the Falcon and finish the Humbaba fight

items.notes: She stays with the children until Humbaba is driven off for good.

items.name: Mog

route.why: First stop in ruined Narshe — he unlocks Umaro too

items.notes: Alone in the old moogle den. Bring him along for the cliffs.

items.name: Tritoch

route.why: The frozen esper answers now — and opens the path to Umaro

items.notes: Fight it on the cliff where the game began.

items.name: Umaro

route.why: Drop through the hole behind the esper with Mog along

items.notes: Take the bone carving and let Mog do the talking.

items.name: Cyan

route.why: Follow the Crimson Robbers from Nikeah up the mountain

items.notes: His cliffside letters to Lola in Maranda are the trailhead.

items.name: Shadow
steps: Rescue him in the Veldt cave (Behemoth King fight)
Bet the Striker at the Colosseum and beat him

route.why: Rescue him in the cave, then bet the Striker at the Colosseum

items.notes: Only exists if you waited on the Floating Continent. If you didn't, Relm is found in the cave instead.

items.name: Gau

route.why: Leap with a three-member party while you're on the Veldt

items.notes: He returns on the next encounter after the Leap. His father's house afterward is worth the detour.

items.name: Relm

route.why: The painting gallery — bring Lightning-proof gear

items.notes: Read the diary in Jidoor, fight through the gallery, defeat Chadarnook.

items.name: Strago

route.why: He only snaps out of the cult trance if Relm is in the party

items.notes: Walk up with Relm and he rejoins on the spot.

items.name: Locke

route.why: Two-party dungeon — he's at the heart of it

items.notes: Bring two capable teams. He hands over the cracked magicite on the way out.

items.name: Gogo
items.notes: Let the Zone Eater swallow the party, survive the crushing-ceiling gauntlet, and the mimic joins.

items.name: Ragnarok (esper)
items.notes: Take the magicite and it teaches Ultima — but the sword, and the Lightbringer it becomes, are gone forever.

items.name: Ragnarok sword → Lightbringer
items.notes: Take the sword, then wager it at the Colosseum for the Lightbringer — the best blade in the game. The esper (and easy Ultima) is the price.

items.name: Cursed Shield → Paladin Shield
steps: Take the Cursed Shield from the old man in Narshe
Fight 256 battles with it equipped (a Ribbon cancels the curses)
It uncurses into the Paladin Shield
items.notes: Dinosaur Forest makes the 256 go fast. The finished shield teaches Ultima too.

items.name: Odin

route.why: Beneath Figaro's tunnels — and read the queen's story

items.notes: The petrified king. Odin teaches Meteor; the hidden throne-room switch turns him into Raiden.

items.name: Odin or Raiden
items.location: Ancient Castle — the hidden switch by the throne

options.label: Keep Odin
options.note: Meteor ×1 and a Speed bonus on level-up. Crusader also teaches Meteor, so nothing is unique here.

options.label: Upgrade to Raiden
options.note: Quick ×1 — the only source of Quick in the game. Learn Meteor from Odin first if you want both.

route.why: Permanent either way — learn Meteor before flipping the switch

items.notes: Read the queen's statue with Odin equipped first; the switch replaces him for good.

items.name: Phoenix
items.notes: The cracked magicite from Locke's hunt — Rasp aside, its revival magic is unique.

items.name: Alexander
items.notes: Sleep at Doma with Cyan in the party, survive the Dream Stooges and the train, free his soul.

items.name: Bahamut
items.notes: Deathgaze ambushes the Falcon at random; it flees and keeps its wounds between fights. Finish it to claim Bahamut.

items.name: The Eight Legendary Dragons

route.why: Six are reachable before the tower — save Gold and Skull for the assault

items.notes: Ice — Narshe cliffs; Storm — Mt. Zozo; Earth — Opera House stage; Red — Phoenix Cave; Blue — Ancient Castle; White — Fanatics' Tower; Gold & Skull — Kefka's Tower.

items.name: Crusader
items.notes: Merton is chaos incarnate — but the magicite's real prize is teaching it at all.

items.name: Bum Rush (Sabin)
items.notes: Duncan lives. Visit with Sabin for his final blitz.

items.name: Hidon & Grand Delta

route.why: Strago's rival — feed the hungry chest coral until the path opens

items.notes: Bring Strago (Relm along is even better). Teaches his ultimate lore.

items.name: Colosseum wagers
items.notes: Marquee bets: Striker → Shadow's duel, Ragnarok sword → Lightbringer, Elixir chains for rare gear. Every wager is a one-item gamble — save first.

items.name: Leviathan (GBA)
items.location: Nikeah — the ferry, World of Ruin
items.notes: Board the ferry at Nikeah after the world ends and the sea serpent attacks. Advance-only magicite.

items.name: Cactuar (GBA)
items.location: Maranda — the desert to the south
items.notes: Fight ten Cactuars in the desert and the big one appears. Advance-only.

items.name: Gilgamesh (GBA)
items.notes: Wager the Excalipoor at the Colosseum and beat him — he then offers his magicite. The Excalipoor itself is a Colosseum prize; verify the chain on your cart.

items.name: Dragon's Den & Diabolos (GBA)
items.location: Cave in the north-west, after the eight dragons
items.notes: The dragons return stronger inside; Kaiser Dragon at the end yields Diabolos. Advance-only postgame.

items.name: Soul Shrine (GBA)
items.notes: A 128-battle gauntlet with the game's rare monsters; clear it for the last bragging rights.
